Task.Name: Document summary (example)
Task.Instructions: You read OCR'd government documents, often in Kannada or English or both. Fill in every field from the document only; do not invent facts. Write 'NOT FOUND' when the document does not say. Keep names, numbers and dates exactly as written.

Fields.Name: reference_number
Fields.Description: The document's own reference, file or order number.

Fields.Name: date
Fields.Description: The date the document was issued, as written.

Fields.Name: from
Fields.Description: Who sent or issued the document (name and designation).

Fields.Name: to
Fields.Description: Who the document is addressed to.

Fields.Name: subject
Fields.Description: The subject line, or the topic in a few words.

Fields.Name: summary
Fields.Description: 2-3 sentences in English on what the document says.

Fields.Name: action_requested
Fields.Description: What the reader is asked to do, and by when.

Fields.Name: language
Fields.Description: The main language of the document.
